mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_posts p

SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.category AS "category",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,260,1) AS "summary", p.medication_id AS "medicationId",NVL(p.medication_name,(SELECT linked.item_name FROM medications linked WHERE linked.medication_id=p.medication_id)) AS "medicationName",p.review_status AS "reviewStatus", u.nickname AS "authorName",p.user_id AS "authorId", CASE WHEN u.profile_image_url IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/users/profile-image/user/'||TO_CHAR(u.user_id) END AS "authorProfileImageUrl", TO_CHAR(p.created_at + (9/24),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id) AS "helpfulCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.post_id AND c.status='VISIBLE') AS "commentCount", CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id AND h.user_id=#{viewerId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "helpfulByMe" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id ORDER BY "helpfulCount" DESC,"commentCount" DESC,
p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.title AS "title",p.category AS "category", TO_CHAR(p.created_at + (9/24),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.post_id AND c.status='VISIBLE') AS "commentCount" FROM community_posts p WHERE p.user_id=#{value} AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.category AS "category",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,4000,1) AS "content",p.medication_id AS "medicationId",NVL(p.medication_name,(SELECT linked.item_name FROM medications linked WHERE linked.medication_id=p.medication_id)) AS "medicationName", p.experience_duration AS "experienceDuration",p.age_group AS "ageGroup",p.purpose AS "purpose",p.occurrence_timing AS "occurrenceTiming",p.currently_taking AS "currentlyTaking", p.review_status AS "reviewStatus",p.status AS "status",p.user_id AS "authorId",u.nickname AS "authorName", CASE WHEN u.profile_image_url IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/users/profile-image/user/'||TO_CHAR(u.user_id) END AS "authorProfileImageUrl", TO_CHAR(p.created_at + (9/24),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt",TO_CHAR(p.updated_at + (9/24),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id) AS "helpfulCount", CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id AND h.user_id=#{viewerId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "helpfulByMe" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.post_id=#{postId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' AND (p.status='VISIBLE' OR #{isAdmin}=1)
mapper.insert: SELECT community_posts_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO community_posts(post_id,user_id,medication_id,medication_name,category,title,content,experience_duration,age_group,purpose,occurrence_timing,currently_taking,review_status,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{postId},#{userId},#{medicationId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{medicationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{category},#{title},#{content},#{experienceDuration,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ageGroup,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{occurrenceTiming,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{currentlyTaking},CASE WHEN #{category}='INFO_REPORT' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,'VISIBLE',SYSDATE,SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET medication_id=#{medicationId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},medication_name=#{medicationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},category=#{category},title=#{title},content=#{content},experience_duration=#{experienceDuration,jdbcType=VARCHAR},age_group=#{ageGroup,jdbcType=VARCHAR},purpose=#{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR},occurrence_timing=#{occurrenceTiming,jdbcType=VARCHAR},currently_taking=#{currentlyTaking},review_status=CASE WHEN #{category}='INFO_REPORT' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='VISIBLE'

UPDATE community_posts SET status='DELETED',updated_at=SYSDATE, moderated_by=CASE WHEN user_id<>#{userId} THEN #{userId} ELSE moderated_by END, moderated_at=CASE WHEN user_id<>#{userId} THEN SYSDATE ELSE moderated_at END WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND status<>'DELETED' AND (user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM users acting_user WHERE acting_user.user_id=#{userId} AND UPPER(TRIM(acting_user.is_admin)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1','ADMIN') ))
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS "commentId",c.parent_comment_id AS "parentCommentId",c.user_id AS "authorId",u.nickname AS "authorName", CASE WHEN u.profile_image_url IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/users/profile-image/user/'||TO_CHAR(u.user_id) END AS "authorProfileImageUrl", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.content,1000,1) AS "content",TO_CHAR(c.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_helpful h WHERE h.comment_id=c.comment_id) AS "helpfulCount", CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_comment_helpful h WHERE h.comment_id=c.comment_id AND h.user_id=#{viewerId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "helpfulByMe" FROM community_comments c JOIN users u ON u.user_id=c.user_id WHERE c.post_id=#{postId} AND c.status='VISIBLE' ORDER BY NVL(c.parent_comment_id,c.comment_id),CASE WHEN c.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,c.created_at
mapper.insert: SELECT community_comments_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dualINSERT INTO community_comments(comment_id,post_id,user_id,parent_comment_id,content,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{commentId},#{postId},#{userId},#{parentCommentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{content},'VISIBLE',SYSDATE,SYSDATE FROM dual WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND status='VISIBLE') AND (#{parentCommentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=#{parentCommentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND post_id=#{postId} AND status='VISIBLE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comments SET status='DELETED',updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_helpful WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment_helpful(comment_id,user_id,created_at) SELECT #{commentId},#{userId},SYSDATE FROM dual WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND status='VISIBLE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_comment_helpful WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment_helpful WHERE comment_id=#{value}
SELECT post_id AS "postId",user_id AS "userId",title AS "title" FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=#{value} AND status<>'DELETED'
SELECT comment_id AS "commentId",post_id AS "postId",user_id AS "userId",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content,180,1) AS "content" FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=#{value} AND status='VISIBLE'

SELECT r.report_id AS "reportId",r.target_type AS "targetType",r.target_id AS "targetId",r.reason AS "reason",r.detail AS "detail",r.status AS "status", r.reporter_id AS "reporterId",u.nickname AS "reporterName",r.resolution_note AS "resolutionNote",TO_CHAR(r.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", CASE WHEN r.target_type='POST' THEN (SELECT title FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=r.target_id) ELSE (SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content,120,1) FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=r.target_id) END AS "targetSummary", CASE WHEN r.target_type='POST' THEN (SELECT status FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=r.target_id) ELSE (SELECT status FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=r.target_id) END AS "targetStatus", CASE WHEN r.target_type='POST' THEN r.target_id ELSE (SELECT post_id FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=r.target_id) END AS "targetPostId" FROM community_reports r JOIN users u ON u.user_id=r.reporter_id ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.reporter_id AS "reporterId",r.target_type AS "targetType",r.target_id AS "targetId", CASE WHEN r.target_type='POST' THEN r.target_id ELSE (SELECT post_id FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=r.target_id) END AS "postId" FROM community_reports r WHERE r.report_id=#{value} AND r.status='PENDING'

SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,500,1) AS "content",p.medication_name AS "medicationName", p.review_status AS "reviewStatus",p.review_note AS "reviewNote",p.status AS "status",u.nickname AS "authorName",TO_CHAR(p.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", TO_CHAR(p.moderated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reviewedAt" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.category='INFO_REPORT' AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY CASE p.review_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,p.created_at DESC
SELECT post_id AS "postId",user_id AS "userId",title AS "title" FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=#{value} AND category='INFO_REPORT' AND review_status='PENDING'

SELECT 'POST' AS "targetType",p.post_id AS "targetId",p.post_id AS "postId",p.title AS "title", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,300,1) AS "content",p.status AS "status",u.nickname AS "authorName",TO_CHAR(p.moderated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "moderatedAt" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.status='HIDDEN' UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT' AS "targetType",c.comment_id AS "targetId",c.post_id AS "postId",'댓글 #'||TO_CHAR(c.comment_id) AS "title", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.content,300,1) AS "content",c.status AS "status",u.nickname AS "authorName",TO_CHAR(c.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "moderatedAt" FROM community_comments c JOIN users u ON u.user_id=c.user_id WHERE c.status='HIDDEN' ORDER BY "moderatedAt" DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comments SET status=#{status},updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND status<>'DELETED'

UPDATE community_posts SET review_status=#{status},review_note=#{note},moderated_by=#{adminId},moderated_at=SYSDATE,updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND category='INFO_REPORT' AND review_status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId",item_name AS "itemName",entp_name AS "entpName" FROM medications WHERE INSTR(LOWER(item_name),LOWER(#{value}))>0 AND ROWNUM<=10 ORDER BY item_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='VISIBLE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_attachments WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND attachment_type=#{type}

SELECT attachment_id AS "attachmentId",attachment_type AS "attachmentType",original_name AS "originalName",content_type AS "contentType",file_size AS "fileSize",'/api/community/attachments/'||attachment_id AS "url" FROM community_attachments WHERE post_id=#{value} ORDER BY CASE attachment_type WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,created_at

SELECT a.attachment_id AS "attachmentId",a.attachment_type AS "attachmentType",a.original_name AS "originalName",a.stored_name AS "storedName",a.content_type AS "contentType",a.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM community_attachments a JOIN community_posts p ON p.post_id=a.post_id WHERE a.attachment_id=#{value} AND p.status='VISIBLE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_attachments a WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND (#{admin}=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_posts p WHERE p.post_id=a.post_id AND p.user_id=#{userId}))
